eraEvidence.basis: The expansion encounter is intentionally retained, but Publish 14.1 player progression has no NGE expertise_healing_reduction statistic. The encounter authors supplied a fixed heal amount and a separate eight-step sacrifice-buff ladder.

The removed arithmetic was the only NGE expertise reference in open_hand.java and could reduce the authored 125000-point heal according to an expertise-derived stat on the boss.
